entries.title: Psalms 144:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David.> Praise be to the God of my strength, teaching my hands the use of the sword, and my fingers the art of fighting:

entries.title: Psalms 144:2
segments: He is my strength, and my Rock; my high tower, and my saviour; my keeper and my hope: he gives me authority over my people.

entries.title: Psalms 144:3
segments: Lord, what is man, that you keep him in mind? or the son of man that you take him into account?

entries.title: Psalms 144:4
segments: Man is like a breath: his life is like a shade which is quickly gone.

entries.title: Psalms 144:5
segments: Come down, O Lord, from your heavens: at your touch let the mountains give out smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 144:6
segments: With your storm-flames send them in flight: send out your arrows for their destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 144:7
segments: Put out your hand from on high; make me free, take me safely out of the great waters, and out of the hands of strange men;

entries.title: Psalms 144:8
segments: In whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 144:9
segments: ¶I will make a new song to you, O God; I will make melody to you on an instrument of ten cords.

entries.title: Psalms 144:10
segments: It is God who gives salvation to kings; and who kept his servant David from the wounding sword.

entries.title: Psalms 144:11
segments: Make me free, and take me out of the hands of strange men, in whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 144:12
segments: Our sons are like tall young plants; and our daughters like the shining stones of a king's house;

entries.title: Psalms 144:13
segments: Our store-houses are full of all good things; and our sheep give birth to thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

entries.title: Psalms 144:14
segments: Our oxen are well weighted down; our cows give birth safely; there is no going out, and there is no cry of sorrow in our open places.

entries.title: Psalms 144:15
segments: Happy is the nation whose ways are so ordered: yes, happy is the nation whose God is the Lord.
